Research

Nozzle topology optimization for multimaterial 3D printing

Johns Hopkins University · Aug 2024 – present

Topology optimization of fluid switching nozzles that give clean multimaterial transitions in material extrusion 3D printing. The formulations are custom weak-form finite element models, built in COMSOL through MATLAB LiveLink.

Presented2026 MRS Spring Meeting & Exhibit, Honolulu, Apr 29, 2026. MRS profile

Battery liquid cooling plates

King Mongkut's University of Technology Thonburi · 2020 – 2022

A multi-objective topology optimization framework coupling battery heat generation with the cooling flow. The optimized plates reduced pressure drop and hot spots against benchmark designs, and led to a patent and a journal paper.

Built & simulated

Optimized designs that were built, and the simulations behind them. Scroll sideways.

Applied work

Lattice dental implants, now in clinical use

KMUTT · with OsseoLabs

Designed additively manufactured porous lattice dental implants and simulated their nonlinear behavior in Abaqus. The design is used in real cases in Southeast Asia through OsseoLabs.

I also represented OsseoLabs at the Startup Grind Global Conference at the Fox Theatre in Redwood City, California.

Electric motorcycle components

Edison Motor / Qres, Thailand · Aug 2021 – Mar 2024 · Project lead

Pitched and led a project applying topology optimization to brackets, the front fork and the battery cooling system. The startup raised up to $60,000 in Thai government funding.

Satellite thermal modeling

mu Space Corp, Bangkok · Jun – Aug 2021 · Aerospace engineering intern

A finite element thermal model of a satellite, and the design of a thermal vacuum chamber for component testing.
